jobs.title: Senior Risk Management Consultant (IRM / TPRM)
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world’s most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com

DXC Vietnam  has been recognized as one of the " Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2025 " by HR Asia Magazine, highlighting its exceptional HR practices and 31-year legacy in the country. The company also earned the special " Most Caring Company Award" in 2025  for prioritizing employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive workplace culture.

We are seeking a Senior Risk Management Consultant to join large-scale risk transformation initiatives focused on Integrated Risk Management (IRM) and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).
In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, risk and compliance teams, and technology stakeholders to design and implement modern risk management solutions. You will act as the bridge between business requirements and solution delivery teams, helping organizations enhance governance, strengthen risk oversight, and improve third-party risk management capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with strong risk management and consulting experience who are looking to contribute to complex transformation programs within the banking and financial services sector. [Senior Ris...sultant 1 | Word]

What You'll Do

Business & Stakeholder Advisory
- Facilitate workshops with business, risk, compliance, procurement, vendor management, and technology stakeholders.
- Analyze existing operational risk and third-party risk management processes, policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and define future-state operating models.
- Gather and translate business requirements into functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Risk & Governance Consulting
- Provide expertise across Operational Risk Management and Third-Party Risk Management domains.
- Advise stakeholders on risk taxonomy, risk and control libraries, RCSA, KRIs, risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.
- Support end-to-end third-party risk management processes, including due diligence, onboarding, risk assessment, monitoring, reassessment, and offboarding.
- Review risk models, questionnaires, policies, controls, and governance frameworks to align with target solution designs.

Solution Delivery & Transformation
- Collaborate with architects, developers, ServiceNow consultants, integration specialists, and project teams throughout delivery.
- Define requirements for workflows, risk scoring methodologies, assessments, reports, dashboards, and approvals.
- Support data migration activities and validate risk, control, assessment, and third-party data.
- Participate in solution demos, testing, UAT, training, and knowledge transfer activities.
- Manage requirement traceability and support project governance by identifying risks, issues, and dependencies.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Banking, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- 7+ years of experience in risk management, governance, banking transformation, consulting, or related areas.
- Strong knowledge of Operational Risk Management and Third-Party Risk Management practices.
- Experience engaging with senior business, risk, and technology stakeholders.
- Ability to translate business processes and policies into practical functional requirements and solution designs.
- Experience with risk assessments, controls, KRIs, issue management, remediation tracking, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring activities.
- Understanding of governance, internal controls, and regulatory expectations within financial services.
- Excellent analytical, facilitation, documentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Strong communication skills in both Vietnamese and English.
- Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and technical delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working for banks, financial institutions, or financial services organizations.
- Background in risk, compliance, procurement, vendor risk, or governance transformation projects.
- Exposure to ServiceNow IRM, ServiceNow TPRM, or other enterprise GRC platforms.
- Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog management, and user stories.
- Experience with system integrations, data migration, testing, and business-user training.
- Professional certifications in risk management, governance, audit, compliance, or third-party risk management.

Employee Benefits and Perks
At DXC Vietnam, we follow a people‑first philosophy, offering competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support your professional growth and personal well‑being.
- Attractive and competitive salary package
- Full salary‑based contributions to Social Insurance, Health Insurance, and Unemployment Insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law
- 13th‑month salary (guaranteed)
- Generous leave policy: 12 annual leave days, 6 personal leave days, 1 volunteer leave day, plus sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and childcare leave.
- Premium Healthcare Insurance (1+1) for employees and dependents
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential 1:1 consultation for physical and mental well‑being to support you and your family
- Access to the Well‑being Hub covering health, mental wellness, and financial planning
- Extensive resources to support your onboarding and continual development including DXC University and sponsorship for professional certification exams.
- DXC Recognition, our global virtual platform that fosters a culture of appreciation and celebration with real-time reward and recognition
- Opportunities to work on global projects, collaborate with international teams, and explore overseas assignments or relocation
- Special allowances and gifts (English/Japanese language allowance, wedding gifts, newborn gifts, etc.)
- Annual team activities and company events
- A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment that promotes knowledge sharing and continuous growth

How to Apply & Our Commitment to You
If you would like to be part of a culture that drives innovation, delivers results, rewards performance, and encourages ideas, please click  “Apply Now”  to submit your resume.
In return, we are committed to providing a hiring experience that is transparent, fair, and engaging. Interviews and onboarding are conducted online as part of DXC’s  virtual ‑ first  approach to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer
DXC Technology is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and celebrate diversity as a source of strength. We believe in bringing your whole self to work, and our company grows only when our people grow.
Reasonable accommodation for qualified candidates may be made in accordance with the DXC Accommodation Policy, including support for individuals with physical and mental disabilities.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Director Business Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description:
Job location: Open to anywhere within the USA

Essential Job Functions:
• Partner with clients, executive stakeholders, and internal teams to define and execute business and technology transformation strategies across the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance value chain.
• Lead modernization programs, developing transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, and business cases that align technology investments with measurable business outcomes.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by assessing current-state operations, technology landscapes, and target-state architectures to accelerate digital transformation.
• Champion the adoption of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions, driving innovative approaches to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
• Provide deep expertise in P&C insurance business processes, core insurance platforms, and emerging technologies, guiding transformation initiatives from strategy through execution.
• Lead cross-functional teams consisting of business consultants, architects, technology leaders, and delivery teams to successfully execute complex transformation programs.
• Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for modernization through core system transformation, cloud adoption, low-code/no-code platforms, data modernization, and process automation.
• Develop executive-level presentations, strategic recommendations, and value realization frameworks that support investment decisions and transformation governance.
• Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies to provide strategic insights and thought leadership to clients and internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Insurance, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Typically 15+ years of experience in business transformation, consulting, technology modernization, or digital transformation, with significant experience in the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
• Demonstrated expertise in developing transformation strategies, business cases, operating models, and implementation roadmaps.
• Strong knowledge of P&C insurance operations, products, distribution channels, claims, underwriting, policy administration, and core insurance systems.
• Experience leading large, cross-functional teams and managing complex client engagements from strategy through execution.
• Proven ability to engage executive stakeholders and influence business and technology decisions.
• Strong understanding of AI, automation, cloud technologies, digital platforms, and low-code/no-code solutions.
• Continuous learner with a passion for emerging technologies and industry innovation.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or related graduate degree.
• Experience with leading P&C core platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar insurance solutions.
• Experience implementing AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, or digital transformation initiatives at enterprise scale.
• Industry certifications in cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, agile methodologies, or insurance disciplines.
• Proven track record of driving business value through technology modernization and organizational transformation programs.

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $139,200 - $289,000.
Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program.  DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

jobs.description:

At DXC we use the power of technology to deliver mission critical IT services that our customers need to modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT estate. We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing and modern workplace.
Our DXC account teams advise, create, orchestrate and drive value for customers by bringing the best of DXC to our customers. Customers ask us to help them solve their most critical technology needs and we proactively share relevant ideas, insights and experience to create a plan for addressing those needs.

We are seeking a Territory Sales Operations Manager to drive sales performance, operational excellence, and revenue growth across the territory. Joining DXC connects you to brilliant people who embrace change and seize opportunities to advance their careers and amplify customer success. jobs.title: Operations Manager, Insurance Call Center
jobs.description:
Job Description:
DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

About The Role:
We are seeking an experienced Manager, Contact Center Operations to lead day-to-day customer support center operations within a complex, multi-account delivery environment.
This role will lead teams of Associate Managers, analysts, and contact center professionals, with accountability for service-level performance, quality, productivity, customer experience, workforce utilization, and continuous improvement.
Working closely with Contact Center Operations leadership and cross-functional partners, you will translate business and client priorities into effective operational execution. You will help ensure teams consistently meet performance objectives while identifying opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance the customer experience.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who combines strong people leadership with analytical problem-solving and a continuous improvement mindset. You will play an important role in driving consistent execution, developing talent, and supporting the adoption of automation and AI-enabled solutions across the contact center.

What You’ll Do
Manage Operational Performance
- Lead day-to-day contact center operations and ensure performance against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, productivity targets, and customer experience objectives.
- Monitor operational performance and use data and reporting to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
- Establish clear expectations and accountability for team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and implement action plans to address performance gaps.
- Ensure consistent execution of client requirements, operational procedures, and business priorities.

Lead and Develop Teams
- Directly manage Associate Managers, analysts, and/or other contact center team members.
- Coach and develop leaders to improve employee performance, engagement, and retention.
- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
- Identify development opportunities and support talent and succession planning.
- Recognize high performance and address performance issues in a timely and effective manner.

Drive Process Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve contact center processes, workflows, quality, and productivity.
- Use root-cause analysis to identify and resolve recurring operational and customer experience issues.
- Implement process improvements that increase efficiency, consistency, and service quality.
- Share and adopt best practices across teams and delivery locations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives using structured methodologies and data-driven approaches.

Support Workforce and Resource Optimization
- Partner with the Workforce Management Manager to align staffing and scheduling with customer demand and operational requirements.
- Monitor staffing, capacity, utilization, productivity, and service-level performance.
- Identify opportunities to improve resource utilization while maintaining customer and quality objectives.
- Support forecasting, capacity planning, and operational planning activities.

Improve Customer Experience
- Monitor customer experience metrics, quality results, feedback, and operational trends.
- Identify root causes of customer issues and implement appropriate corrective actions.
- Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, quality, and overall service experience.
- Ensure teams understand how operational performance directly impacts the customer.

Collaborate Across Teams
- Partner with Contact Center Operations leadership to execute operational priorities and account objectives.
- Work closely with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Technology, Finance, HR, and other functional teams.
- Collaborate with client and internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues and improve service delivery.
- Support consistency and best-practice sharing across the Americas, Canada, Costa Rica, and the Philippines .
- Communicate operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities clearly to leadership.

Maintain Compliance & Operational Controls
- Ensure teams follow client, regulatory, contractual, and internal policies and procedures.
- Maintain strong quality and operational controls within the contact center.
- Support audits, compliance reviews, and remediation activities as required.
- Promote a culture of quality, risk awareness, and operational discipline.

What You’ll Bring
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.
- 10+ years of contact center, BPO, or BPS experience, including significant people leadership experience.
- 5+ years of experience managing contact center operations , preferably in a BPO/BPS environment.
- Demonstrated experience managing managers, team leaders, or other operational leadership roles.
- Strong understanding of contact center KPIs, including SLAs, AHT, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and service-level performance.
- Experience working in multi-channel customer support environments and with contact center technologies.
- Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
- Demonstrated experience implementing process improvements and driving operational performance.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting Financial Services or Life & Annuity insurance operations.
- Experience working across multiple accounts, sites, or geographic locations.
- Experience with Workforce Management and capacity planning.
- Familiarity with contact center automation, AI, analytics, and digital technologies.
- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
- Experience working with global delivery teams.

What Success Looks Like
Operational Excellence
- Consistently meets or exceeds SLA, KPI, quality, and productivity objectives.
- Uses operational data to identify issues early and drive timely corrective action.
- Maintains strong execution and accountability across teams.

People Leadership
- Develops capable, engaged, and high-performing teams.
- Coaches managers and employees to achieve performance and development goals.
- Builds a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Role Purpose

The Program Manager
Airports lead the delivery of a major stream or set of related projects within the airport programs, accountable for coordinated delivery of scope, schedule, cost, quality and benefits across multiple projects.
Operating under the Program Director, the role drives cross-project planning, dependency management and delivery, ensuring workstreams combine into a coherent, on-track programs in a 24/7 operational environment.

Key Responsibilities
Programme-Stream Delivery
- Plan and deliver a portfolio of related projects, managing cross-project dependencies and integration.
- Own the stream schedule, budget and resource plan; track progress and manage the critical path.
- Coordinate technical, operational and vendor teams to achieve delivery objectives.

Risk, Change & Governance
- Own stream-level RAID and change control; escalate to the Program Director and PMO as required.
- Assure quality, safety, security and compliance; support readiness, transition and go-live.
- Operate within program governance and standards.

Commercial & Stakeholder
- Manage stream budget, forecasting and supplier performance.
- Build strong relationships with client, operational and vendor stakeholders.
- Lead and develop project managers and teams within the stream.
-

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Program/multi-project delivery:  Proven experience managing multiple related projects or a delivery stream to time, cost and quality.
- Methodology:  Strong command of program/project methods (PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, agile/hybrid).
- Planning & control:  Skilled in cross-project planning, dependency, budget and risk management.
- Leadership:  Ability to lead project managers and multi-disciplinary, multi-vendor teams.
- Stakeholder management:  Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Desirable
- Experience in aviation, airports or comparable 24/7 critical-infrastructure environments.
- Familiarity with airport programs (terminal openings, ORAT/transition).
- Exposure to MSI delivery models.
- Programs/project certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, MSP) and/or SAFe.

Qualifications
- Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
- Program/project certification strongly preferred (PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or equivalent).

Key Competencies
Delivery accountability - cross-project orchestration - planning - stakeholder influence - risk management - leadership - resilience - customer focus.
